---
applyTo: "README.md"
---

# Readme Instructions

- README Files should be structured with the following sections in order:

  - Project Title and Description
  - Prerequisites
  - Setup Overview
  - How to use
  - Notes
  - Contributing

- Screenshots should be included when relevant to demonstrate what output looks like or to guide the reader
in a step by step fashion throught a UI (like the azure portal)

- Where a screenshot would be relevant, position a marker with a description of the screenshot: <<SCREENSHOT: <Description> >>

- Avoid using emdash, use other punctuations instead

## Setup Overview

The goal of the setup overview section is to depict the infrastructure elements involved in the sample.

The reader should be able to visualize the infrastructure elements and key interactions between them.

It is comprise of:
- Diagram depicting the structure
- Text description of the structure

Provide the following text placeholder for the position of the diagram: <<DIAGRAM: <description of the diagram> >>

# Examples

The following README.md files can be considered as good examples:
